chapter.title: Guilds and Guild Halls
chapter.summary: 5.0 adds Guild Halls with career contract boards, and guild rank as a second ladder on top of faction reputation.

objectives.title: Visit a Guild Hall and read its boards
objectives.why: In 5.0, Guild Halls are where career contracts come from. Each hall's boards depend on the locations around it.

steps.do: Fly to a Guild Hall (they are on Nyx I in the 5.0 PTU).
steps.done_when: You are inside the Guild Hall.

steps.do: Open a Career Contract Board. The terminals are labelled by guild: ITG Contracts, Merc. Contracts, URW Contracts or AOS Contracts.
steps.done_when: You see tabs for the factions offering contracts nearby.

steps.do: Look at a Notice Board too. Its local jobs pay credits but give no faction or guild reputation.
steps.done_when: You know which board pays reputation and which only pays credits.

objectives.tips: Guild Halls were not armistice zones in early 5.0 PTU builds; CIG said it is working on it. Watch your ship.

objectives.title: Interstellar Transport Guild: reach Jr. Contractor (513)
objectives.why: Higher-ranked hauling and courier contracts need guild rank as well as company rank. Covalex hauls and FTL courier runs give 100-200 ITG rank each.

steps.do: Take ITG contracts from a Career Contract Board (for example Covalex's "Large Multi-Delivery Supply Run"). Log each one below.
steps.done_when: Your Interstellar Transport Guild rank shows Jr. Contractor.

objectives.title: Interstellar Transport Guild: reach Contractor (2,051)
objectives.why: About 150 ITG rank per contract at this stage.

steps.do: Keep taking ITG contracts. Log each one below.
steps.done_when: Your Interstellar Transport Guild rank shows Contractor.

objectives.title: Mercenary Guild: reach Jr. Contractor (513)
objectives.why: Combat career contracts can need Mercenary Guild rank even with strong faction reputation. Bounty Hunters Guild work gives 100-300 Mercenary Guild rank.

steps.do: Take Mercenary Guild contracts from a Merc. Contracts board. Log each one below.
steps.done_when: Your Mercenary Guild rank shows Jr. Contractor.

objectives.title: Mercenary Guild: reach Contractor (2,051)
objectives.why: About 200 Mercenary Guild rank per contract at this stage.

steps.do: Keep taking Mercenary Guild contracts. Log each one below.
steps.done_when: Your Mercenary Guild rank shows Contractor.

objectives.title: United Resource Workers: reach Jr. Contractor (513)
objectives.why: The resource guild. Shubin's mining purchase orders give 100-250 URW rank each.

steps.do: Take contracts from a URW Contracts board (for example Shubin purchase orders). Log each one below.
steps.done_when: Your United Resource Workers rank shows Jr. Contractor.

objectives.title: United Resource Workers: reach Contractor (2,051)
objectives.why: About 200 URW rank per contract at this stage.

steps.do: Keep taking URW contracts. Log each one below.
steps.done_when: Your United Resource Workers rank shows Contractor.
